Package com.bilt.pos.session.basket

Class Basket

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.basket.Basket
public final class Basket extends Object
An immutable snapshot of the session's basket.

Basket mutators on SessionBasket return a fresh snapshot; instances never change and can be held freely by register code.

The payment breakdown fields (rebateTotal, pointDiscountTotal, storedValueTotal, cardPaymentTotal) are zero during cart-building and populated on the snapshots produced during and after payment orchestration.
